lines.zh: 蠕动前行，黏液滴落地面。
lines.en: Creeps forward, oozing slime.
Moves slowly, making gurgling sounds.
Slides on the slick ground.
Creeps around, all slimy.
Seeks out soft, wet soil.
Slime drips onto the ground.
Slides in the mud.
Gooey body moves.
Struggles in the muck.
Slime seeps everywhere.

lines.zh: 四条小短腿，追着母亲跑
lines.en: Four short legs trotting after mother.
Small hooves press over the moss.
Lazily curled up.
Wiggling with closed eyes.
Lying still on the ground.
Gooey body relaxes.
Slowly stretches its body.
Licking its own body.
Curling into a ball to rest.
Touching the ground with tentacles.
Enjoying lazily.
Licking its own foot slowly.
Curled up napping at its parent's feet.

lines.zh: 耳朵一转，听见远处蹄声
lines.en: An ear flicks at hooves far away.
Too small to wander far yet.
Nibbling grass the way its parents do.

lines.zh: 我还没长齐毛，你小声点。
lines.en: My fur isn't full yet; keep your voice down.
Notices the player, body tenses.
Tentacles point at the player.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我整个人还大。
lines.en: Your boot is bigger than my whole body.
Turns its head towards the player.
Approaching the player.
I lift my head, still too young to call out.
Watchful gaze on the player.
Tracking the player's movements.
Only when you crouch do I see you clearly.
It looks up and takes you for an elder.

lines.zh: 歪着脑袋，打量你的靴子
lines.en: Head tilted, studying your boots.

lines.zh: 它还不会怕人，只是好奇
lines.en: It has not learned fear, only curiosity.
Wet eyes fixed on you.
Two steps toward you, then back.
Sniffs your hand, then looks up.
It decides you are new family.
Peeking at you from behind the grass.
I'm too small; the pain makes me cry out.
Go away, I'm sick...
So much pain...
Please, save me...
Injured, very dangerous...
So much pain, I want to run...
Injured, I need to rest...
Injured, I can't move...
I fell over and my nose hurts.
I call loudly so my parents hear.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，你要尝尝我的味道吗？
lines.en: Gurgle, are you tempted to taste me?

lines.zh: 我的肉质鲜美，你尝尝看！
lines.en: My flesh is tender, give it a try!
Don't think about eating me, I'll bite you!

lines.zh: 求求你别杀我，我还可以给你更多！
lines.en: Please don't kill me, I can give you more!
Stay away from me, my friend!
I'm growing, don't eat me!
Your strength can't defeat me!
I just need to protect myself!
I'm small. Just one bite.
Don't kill me, I'll be good!
Ow! You hit me!
Watch out! I'm about to hit you!
Don't come closer! I'll hit you!
Get out of the way, I'm going to hit you!
How stupid are you!
You're blocking my way!
Don't move, I'm going to hit you!
Move, I'm going to hit you!
You're so dumb, you hit me!
Get out of my way, I'm going to hit you!

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，尾巴碰尾巴。
lines.en: We sit side by side, tail against tail.
Do you need a mate?
Mate with me, my同类!
Come on, it's mating time!
Please mate with me!
Mate with me, my lover!
I'm still young; I can only nuzzle you.
Please, let's mate!
Mate with me, my partner!
Mate with me, to reproduce!
Come closer...
Watch out for my fangs!
I was just born; my legs are soft.
This shiny scrap is mine to hide.
I hug it and drag it back to the nest.
My little paws pin it down.
Gurgle gurgle...
Your blood will nourish me!

lines.zh: 这半块面包够我吃很久。
lines.en: Half a loaf will last me a long time.
Follow you; maybe there is food.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就不抖了。
lines.en: You take one step closer, and I stop shaking.
My mother stands behind me.
I am small, but my teeth are all in.
I crouch low and wait for you to bend down.
My legs are still weak; I'll learn to hide first.

lines.zh: 我挡住门口，虽然很害怕。
lines.en: I block the doorway, though I'm scared.

lines.zh: 我个子小，专挑你的脚踝。
lines.en: I'm small, so I go for your ankles.
My teeth haven't grown in, but I won't back down.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，只够到你膝盖。
lines.en: I lunge and only reach your knee.
That young shoot looks worth a try.
Water somewhere; it wants a look.
It hunts a falling leaf.
Chasing a beetle that wandered past.
Its eyes fix on the berries in your hand.
Practicing a pounce, still clumsy.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，却先绊了一跤
lines.en: Target locked, then it trips over itself.
Preparing to attack...

lines.zh: 我学着大人的样子龇牙。
lines.en: I bare my teeth the way the adults do.
Stay alert!
You won't live to leave!

lines.zh: 我还没长大，牙已经尖了。
lines.en: I am not grown yet, but my teeth are sharp.
I'm small, but I'm quick.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出小小的低吼。
lines.en: A tiny growl rises in my throat.
I'm small, but my teeth are sharp.
Your life is in my hands!

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找能咬的地方。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for somewhere to bite.
Crouching low, copying how parents stalk.
Tail taut, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 小爪子在地上刨了两下
lines.en: Little claws scrape the ground twice.
Ears flatten back as it stares.

lines.zh: 它还不知道该怎么下口
lines.en: It still has no idea where to bite.

lines.zh: 步子迈得太大，晃了一下
lines.en: Its stride is too long; it wobbles.
Eyes wide, it charges with everything.
Counting down: three, two, one.
I'm small; my teeth aren't in yet.
I've got teeth, watch out!

lines.zh: 我还没长大，可我已经会咬。
lines.en: I'm not grown yet, but I already bite.
I'll make a big hole in you!
I'll wrap you in my tentacles!
Can you smell me now?
There's no escape, surrender!
I'm stronger than you think!

lines.zh: 我还小，可牙齿已经长齐。
lines.en: I'm small, but my teeth are all in.
Don't fight, I'll make you squirm!
It bumps you with small milk teeth.
It lunges in, then bounces off.
Wild scratching that hits nothing vital.
Baring tiny teeth like its parents.

lines.zh: 整个身子撞向你的膝盖
lines.en: Its whole body hits your knee.
Fierce squeak, very little force.
Here comes my baby!
My little one, grow up!
Find some meat, I need energy!
This is my territory!
Be careful, it's watching!
My baby, go foraging!
Find my nest quickly!
Don't wake my baby!
My baby will inherit me!
Baby, come back to me!
I was born after my parents mated.

lines.zh: 没有刷怪蛋，我从巢里来
lines.en: No spawn egg; I come from a nest.
First time my eyes open; the world is bright.
I am not on any loot table.
I am still only a juvenile.
I open my eyes in a blooming woods nest.
By the swamp, I stand up for the first time.

lines.zh: 松树荒原的洞穴里出生
lines.en: Born in a burrow on the pine barrens.

lines.zh: 快帮我...，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Help me — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 走开，我不舒服...，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Go away, I'm sick — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 好痛，好痛...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: So much pain — and the drown makes it worse.
I hadn't grown up before the blast hit.

lines.zh: 求求你救救我...，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Please, save me — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 受伤了，很危险...，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, very dangerous — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 好痛，我想要逃跑...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: So much pain, I want to run — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 受伤了，我需要休息...，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, I need to rest — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 受伤了，我不能动...，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, I can't move — and the void makes it worse.
